This season I will use both fertilizer and improved seed because the soil in this area needs extra nutrients for a good harvest, and the rains have been reliable enough that I do not need irrigation. My family will do most of the work with hand hoes, but I will hire a few young men from the village to help with the heavy clearing and weeding.
